skills_yaml_draft.description: 多源文献搜索与引文管理，支持 PubMed、CrossRef 等工具，适用于 Nature 论文的学术研究工作流。
skills_yaml_draft.description_en: Multi-source literature search and citation management using tools like PubMed and CrossRef, tailored for Nature-style academic research workflows.

skills_yaml_draft.description: 为手稿文本自动添加符合 Nature/CNS 标准的引用，通过分段搜索和筛选，支持多种参考文献格式输出。
skills_yaml_draft.description_en: Automatically add strict Nature/CNS citations to manuscript text by segmenting passages and searching, with support for multiple reference manager outputs.

skills_yaml_draft.group: 学术数据引用 / FAIR metadata
skills_yaml_draft.description: 为 Nature 系期刊准备、审核或修订 Data Availability 声明、数据仓库选择、数据集引用及 FAIR 元数据检查清单，支持中文作者英译润色。
skills_yaml_draft.description_en: Prepare, audit, or revise Nature-ready Data Availability statements, repository plans, dataset citations, and FAIR metadata checklists—plus CN-to-EN wording polish for Chinese-speaking authors.

skills_yaml_draft.group: 科研出版级图表 / Nature figure workflow
skills_yaml_draft.group_en: Publication-grade scientific figures / Nature figure workflow
skills_yaml_draft.description: 用 Python(matplotlib/seaborn) 或 R(ggplot2/patchwork) 制作符合 Nature 等高影响力期刊投稿规范的多面板科研图表，含结论定义、证据逻辑、导出 QA 全流程。
skills_yaml_draft.description_en: Create submission-grade, multi-panel scientific figures in Python or R for Nature-family and other high-impact journals, covering conclusion design, evidence logic, export, and QA review.

skills_yaml_draft.description: 帮助 AI agent 从科学论文自动构建 Nature 风格中文演示文稿，优化图表选择、幻灯片内容和布局，并运行自我修正循环以确保质量。
skills_yaml_draft.description_en: Assists AI agents in automatically building Nature-style Chinese presentations from scientific papers, with optimized figure selection, slide content, and layout, plus a self-review loop for quality assurance.

skills_yaml_draft.description: 帮助 AI agent 润色学术散文为 Nature 风格英语，涵盖论文各节段的写作策略、句级优化，并修复 LaTeX 排版问题如图表布局和浮动体设置。
skills_yaml_draft.description_en: Assists AI agents in polishing academic prose into Nature-style English, covering writing strategies for each paper section, sentence-level refinement, and LaTeX layout fixes for figures and floats.

skills_yaml_draft.description: 帮助 agent 构建 Nature 论文的中英文对照阅读器，支持 PDF、DOI 等来源，保留图表位置并确保源锚定。
skills_yaml_draft.description_en: Helps agent build Chinese-English side-by-side readers for Nature papers from sources like PDF, DOI, or HTML, preserving figure/table placement and source anchors.

skills_yaml_draft.description: 辅助 agent 起草 Nature 系列期刊的审稿回复信，处理修订请求和反驳信，确保逐点回应。
skills_yaml_draft.description_en: Assists agent in drafting reviewer response letters for Nature-family manuscript revisions, handling revision requests and rebuttals with point-by-point responses.

skills_yaml_draft.description: 根据用户提供的论点、结果或中文草稿，起草或重组Nature风格的学术手稿各部分。
skills_yaml_draft.description_en: Draft or restructure Nature-style academic manuscript sections based on user-provided claims, results, or Chinese drafts.

skills_yaml_draft.description: 生成单文件HTML横向翻页PPT，支持电子杂志和瑞士国际主义两种视觉风格，含WebGL背景、章节幕封、数据大字报、图片网格等模板，适用于分享、演讲等场景。
skills_yaml_draft.description_en: Generates single-file HTML horizontal-swipe slide decks with two visual styles: Editorial Magazine and Swiss International, featuring WebGL backgrounds, section screens, data infographics, image grids, and more, suitable for sharing, presentations, and launches.

skills_yaml_draft.description: 帮助 AI agent 创建、读取、编辑和操纵 Word 文档（.docx），支持格式化、表格、页眉、查找替换、图片插入等功能。
skills_yaml_draft.description_en: Helps AI agents create, read, edit, and manipulate Word documents (.docx), with support for formatting, tables, headers, find-and-replace, image insertion, and more.

skills_yaml_draft.description: 帮助 AI agent 处理 PDF 文件，包括读取文本、合并分割、添加水印、表单填写、加密解密和 OCR 识别等操作。
skills_yaml_draft.description_en: Helps AI agents process PDF files, including text extraction, merging, splitting, watermarking, form filling, encryption/decryption, and OCR recognition.
